answers.reason: Full professors hold chairs and represent the highest academic rank, making them eligible for the university's central academic body.
Central budget allocation is the domain of the university leadership, the chancellor, and faculty deans, which is above a chair holder's rank.
Selecting candidates for a vacant professorship is a standard academic committee duty for a full professor.
Holding a chair in the faculty entitles the full professor to participate in the faculty council.
As a faculty-level body below the faculty council, a full professor is permitted to take part due to their rank and teaching role.
A full professor's high rank in the faculty permits participation in faculty-level examination bodies.
As a research group leader and senior faculty member, the full professor is eligible to participate in awarding internal faculty grants.
Those with a higher office and rank in the faculty may take part in working groups below their level.
A full professor's high rank within the faculty allows participation in subordinate teaching-related decisions.
Because those with a higher rank may take part in bodies below their level, a full professor is permitted to join this faculty planning round.
